node.note: Integration Tests runs the runner with TIER=full-integration, its integration and live files. chaos.yml runs it too, on a schedule with TIER=pr-integration, which is no required check.

playwright.note: No workflow runs playwright test: the Storybook Stories job installs Chromium for vitest browser mode and runs no spec, so both portals' specs reach no required check.

k6.note: performance.yml's k6-load job runs one scenario per run, on push to main and on dispatch, with a name that is an expression of the dispatch input; it is no required check.
